description: Find credit cards by specific benefits, credits, or features. Use when asked "which cards have X credit/benefit?" Searches credit names, feature strings, and benefit categories. Returns cards ranked by total annual credit value.

benefitKeyword.description: Keyword to search in credit names or features (e.g., "instacart", "lounge", "streaming")

minAnnualCreditValue.description: Minimum total annual credit value in dollars
